name: The fort's company gardens: young fruit trees and currant bushes

existence.note: Juliette Kinzie, of the fort she lived beside in 1831: 'Beyond the parade-ground which extended south of the pickets, were the company gardens, well filled with currant-bushes and young fruit-trees.' The planting is attested as the garden record's own `planting` field says; the garden stands to the end of 1836. Every position, the species of the trees and the number of each are reconstructed.
